articles.summary: NEW YORK, June 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SunCar Technology Group Inc. (the “Company” or “SunCar”) (NASDAQ: SDA), a leader in delivering AI-powered B2B auto insurance and services in China, has won the contract to manage auto insurance for Aistaland, a luxury EV brand co-developed by Huawei.
articles.title: SunCar Wins Insurance Management Contract for Aistaland, a Luxury EV Brand Backed by Huawei
